name: Halo Player
author: Tiedeyez
description: Halo in your bar: the song playing in the native Halo music player, with play/pause, next and previous, and a click that brings the Halo window up. The widget only runs the installed /usr/bin/halo command (status, toggle, next, previous, open); it writes no files, edits no configuration and opens no network connection. Needs the Halo app, installed from this repository.

barWidget.description: Now playing in Halo, with play/pause, next and previous
